tasks.description: Zero-resource structured receipt repair for the already completed current gated-horizon training/search provenance audit. The previous audit wrote raw/summary/completed artifacts with completed.passed=true and consumed zero solver/plant/training/validation/test resources, but no outcome_receipt.json was produced, so structured acceptance remained unverified. This repair reads only the existing audit artifacts and run logs, verifies the intended pass-condition evidence, writes compact raw/summary/completed repair artifacts and emits the missing structured receipt. It does not open validation64 generator/bank sources, run controllers/plant/solvers, train/refit, create new validation episodes, or access sealed/final tests.
